name: SVC_HCM_SR_REL_MIG
description: This table is used to backup service requests related tables with ORA_SVC_HCM stripe code only.

columns.name: TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Table name containing stripe_cd that will be updated during HCM to HRHD migration.

columns.name: TABLE_PK
columns.description: Primary key of the table containing stripe_cd that will be updated during HCM to HRHD migration.

columns.name: PK_VALUE
columns.description: Primary key content from the table containing stripe_cd that will be updated during HCM to HRHD migration.

columns.name: MIGRATION_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates whether the record from table_name with ORA_SVC_HCM stripe was migrated to HRHD stripe (Y or N).

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
